Unity Package

ColdSnap Utilities

The Unity package behind every ColdSnap game and kiosk. Platform Builder builds Windows, macOS, Android (APK and App Bundle), WebGL and iOS from one window with saved scene lists, and sends iOS builds to TestFlight from a Windows PC through a macOS runner. Around it: scene quick open, a commit-and-push window, a one-click update check, pivot tools, dark title bars on Windows, a fullscreen WebGL kiosk template and a few runtime helpers. Installs from Git in the Package Manager; versions bump themselves from commit titles.

Features

  • Platform Builder: Windows, macOS, Android, WebGL and iOS from one window
  • Send to TestFlight from Windows (signed on a macOS runner)
  • Scene quick open, Git commit-and-push window, update check
  • Pivot tools, Auto Group, teleport player to the Scene camera
  • WebGL kiosk template and kiosk setup scripts
  • Automatic semantic versioning from commit titles
